incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A brick building with visible structural damage and collapsed sections lies at a street corner, with debris including bricks and wood scattered across the pavement. In the background are other buildings and a traffic light.

observations.description: The brick building shows significant damage, with parts of the roof and upper floors collapsed inward and bricks protruding into the street.
A traffic light pole and traffic signals are visible. A street awning is torn and hanging.
A red vehicle is visible in the distance on the street.
No people are visible in the immediate foreground or midground; distant figures might be present but are indistinct.
Trees are visible in the background behind buildings.
